{{Quote|Hu Jibwe, scholar of military history at the Salmagodro Grand Academy, notes that there is another song popularly known as 'Dha Werda Verda'&mdash;the Mando'a war chant known as 'Rage of the Shadow Warriors.'|Eschul Shaywa, "A LONG TIME AGO..."|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
The '''Salmagodro Grand Academy''' was a higher-education facility<ref name="Author's Cut" /> that shared its name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Salmagodro system/Legends|Salmagodro system]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Its staff included the military history [[Scholar/Legends|scholar]] [[Hu Jibwe]]. The article "[[A LONG TIME AGO...]]"&mdash;written by [[Eschul Shaywa]], published in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] in the periodical ''[[Imperial Center Today]]'', and concerning the scarcity of available historical information on the [[Taung/Legends|Taungs]] and the [[Zhell/Legends|Zhell]], two groups whose [[200,000 BBY|200,000-year-old]] [[Zhell–Taung war|conflict]] was depicted in the ancient epic poem ''[[Dha Werda Verda]]''&mdash;included two pieces of commentary by Hu. The first comment discussed the related, more recent [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] war [[Music/Legends|chant]] "Rage of the Shadow Warriors," while in the second passage Hu contrasted the likely historical inaccuracies of popular depictions of the conflict described in ''Dha Werda Verda'' with the inherent literary qualities of the poem itself.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Salmagodro Grand Academy was originally meant to be introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]. However, ultimately the section mentioning the academy was cut before the book's release. It was later published in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
